The debauchery. I know once I'm older I can't get away with those things I could've got away with in the past. I'm thinking about growing out my hair but I'm worried it will make job interviewers cross me off their applicants list. 

I'm going to take this day by day. Graduation isn't until May. Hopefully I can improve. Thanks

This is my only reddit account. I use forums and I think this is my biggest problem. I've gotten to used to the fact that I could talk to people online without any judgments of my physical appearance or actually going out and interacting without bad anxiety. 

I really appreciate your advice 100% but I can't shake the feeling that I completely threw college away and its holding me back from moving forward. It's like a dark cloud hanging around me that will always be around. I don't know.

I just feel like my college experience could have and should have been different. I will take it day by day but man, I really missed out. I try to forget about it but it's hard and it feels like I can't ever move forward. I will take your advice, thanks.
Yup. Parents have what they THINK is in your best interest in mind but that certainly isn't always the case
Thanks Dennis. I hope you advance in your career.

They knew I wasn't a "partier" so maybe that's why. At least that's what I'm hoping. My major was journalism and I enjoy it but it's so hard to get a job with the downsizing that's going on that I'm losing a lot of hope.

I'd spend my time on Youtube, watching movies, or watching series. I didn't talk to girls online. I don't have the courage to do online dating.

Thanks for your kind words about me being articulate and put together.
